integrity: Direct finite automorphism enumeration and independent all-size group-factorization proof; no independent audit was performed. No claim of new rigidity polynomial or component decomposition.
scientific_limitations: Only finite carriers, one total idempotent unary map and q named exclusive colours. Historical priority remains provisional because a multivariate rooted-star enumeration could already encode the exact order-two stratum; only a targeted excerpt of one tree-automorphism paper was accessible. Finite computational checks are supporting evidence, not infinite proof.
title: The sharp one-involution cutoff for coloured idempotent unary models
